{{NAME_1}}.role: makes a complete circle by making a full turn, one foot fixed, rotating at one spot on the ground (the book says 'Ashutosh made a complete circle')

{{NAME_2}}.role: makes a half-moon shape with a half turn, one foot fixed, rotating at one spot on the ground (the book gives no pronoun)

{{NAME_3}}.role: takes two half turns, then quarter turns, on the giant wheel (the book says 'she')

{{NAME_4}}.role: joins a green and a yellow straw with paper clips, holds the green one steady and turns the yellow one (the book says 'She')

{{NAME_5}}.role: faces the toy shop in the street and takes a half turn clockwise (the book says 'she')

_note_kin: The book names no family members. The four children of the statue game picture are labelled only A, B, C and D and have no names, so they have no token (write them as child A, child B, child C, child D). The teacher of the statue picture is not named and is not used as a teaching character.
